purpose: Curated Persian puzzle entries for review before integration into the game.
notes: Each entry has a Persian clue authored for this project; no random concatenation is used.
Answers are normalized by the game engine by removing spaces and ZWNJ.
This initial seed is manually curated and is not the promised 3000-stage corpus.
